title: 第1513章 你去找佛门吧灵山满座懵逼 取经人怎么可能会死第1512章 孙悟空的忌惮 你这么厉害什么唐僧死了
slug: 洪荒截教大师兄收徒就能变强
lines: 凌霄宝殿里。
透露着一股诡谲的气氛。
在场的神仙们面色都有着一种说不出来的古怪。
唐僧……
被孽龙给吃了？
要知道唐僧乃是西天取经中必不可少的一环。
结果现在唐僧没了。
这还怎么玩？
佛门不得炸开锅了吗？？
“微臣问过当地土地，土地声称亲眼所见。”
罗宣拱了拱手，说道：“那孽龙把唐僧连人带马一起吞了，嚼碎之后咽下去的，尸骨都找不到了。”
“而根据微臣在原地探寻，也未曾发现任何唐僧的踪迹。”
“显然，这条孽龙真的把取经人给吃了！”
殿内又安静了。
没有人说话。
只有殿顶的夜明珠还在发光，光线铺在大殿的金砖地面上，把每一个人的影子都拉得很长，影子的轮廓边缘被灯光染成淡金色，有些发虚！
每个神仙都懵逼错愕的发愣着。
都不知道该说些什么了。
空气里只剩下殿内香炉中袅袅升起的烟，在安静的空气里缓缓散开，从大殿中央的香炉台上攀升，在夜明珠的白色光芒下一点点变淡，扩散成一片若有若无的薄纱。
过了很久，才有人低声说了一句，“这事……得跟灵山那边说吧？”
他的声音在安静的大殿里显得很突兀，像一颗石子落进深水里，沉没之后留下一圈逐渐散开的水纹。
没有人接话。
那声低语落下去之后，殿内又恢复了沉默。
安静了很久，久到能听到殿外风吹过栏杆的声音，细微的呼呼声，像是从很远的地方来的，被殿门前的檐角撕碎了，只带进来几缕凉意。
玉帝坐在高台上，右手搁在龙椅扶手上，食指有一下没一下地敲着。
取经人死了？
被一条小龙给吃了？
他听了罗宣的汇报，面上没露出什么表情，但心里已经过了好几道弯。
西天取经是西方教的事，取经人是金蝉子转世，是如来佛祖的亲传弟子。
这人死了，最该着急的是灵山，不是天庭。
天庭在这件事里不过是配合，该出兵出兵，该出力出力，剩下的不该天庭管。
他敲着扶手，目光在殿内众仙脸上扫了一圈。
罗宣站在下面，面色如常。
哪吒站在稍远的地方，低着头，像是在出神。
殿外的栏杆上，孙悟空蹲在那里，背对着殿内，看那后脑勺的姿态，也不知道在琢磨什么。
玉帝心里琢磨了一下，开口了，声音不大，但刚好能让殿外的人也能听见。
“兹事体大。”
他说道：“孙悟空，这次得由你专门跑一趟灵山，看看这件事情该如何处理。”
“降妖除魔的事，天庭已经帮你做了，取经人出了这种变故，灵山那边也该知道，该怎么定夺，让灵山自行处理。”
content_en:
In the Lingxiao Palace.
It revealed an eerie atmosphere.
The expressions of the gods present all had an indescribable weirdness.
Tang Monk...
Eaten by an evil dragon?
You must know that Tang Monk is an indispensable part of the Buddhist scriptures in the West.
As a result, Tang Monk is gone now.
How to play this?
Isn’t Buddhism going to explode? ?
"Wei Chen asked about the local land, and the land claimed to have seen it with his own eyes."
Luo Xuan cupped his hands and said, "That evil dragon swallowed up Monk Tang, both his man and his horse. He chewed it up and swallowed it, and even the bones can't be found."
"According to Wei Chen's search in the same place, no trace of Tang Monk was found."
"Obviously, this evil dragon really ate the pilgrim!"
The hall was quiet again.
No one spoke.
Only the luminous pearl on the top of the hall is still shining. The light is spread on the gold brick floor of the hall, making everyone's shadow very long. The edge of the shadow's outline is dyed pale gold by the light, which makes it look a little faint!
Every god was stunned and stunned.
Don't even know what to say.
Only the smoke rising from the incense burner in the hall was left in the air. It slowly dispersed in the quiet air, climbed up from the incense burner in the center of the hall, faded little by little under the white light of the night pearl, and spread into a vague veil.
After a long time, someone whispered, "Should we tell Lingshan about this?"
His voice seemed very abrupt in the quiet hall, like a pebble dropped into deep water, leaving a circle of gradually spreading water ripples after it sank.
No one answered.
After the whisper fell, silence returned in the palace.
It was quiet for a long time, long enough to hear the wind blowing through the railings outside the temple. The subtle whistling sound seemed to come from a far away place, torn apart by the corners of the eaves in front of the temple door, bringing in only a few rays of coolness.
The Jade Emperor sat on the high platform, resting his right hand on the armrest of the dragon chair, tapping his index finger repeatedly.
The pilgrim is dead?
Got eaten by a dragon?
After listening to Luo Xuan's report, he showed no expression on his face, but he had gone through several twists and turns in his heart.
Pursuing Buddhist scriptures from the Western Heaven is a matter of Western teaching. The Buddhist scripture collector is the reincarnation of Jin Chanzi and a direct disciple of Tathagata Buddha.
When this person dies, what should be worried about most is Lingshan, not Heaven.
Heaven is just cooperating in this matter. It should send out troops and strength, and the rest should not be dealt with by Heaven.
He knocked on the armrest and glanced around the faces of the immortals in the hall.
Luo Xuan stood below, his expression as usual.
Nezha stood a little further away with his head lowered, as if he was in a trance.
On the railing outside the hall, Sun Wukong was squatting there, with his back to the hall. Looking at the posture of the back of his head, he didn't know what he was thinking about.
The Jade Emperor thought about it in his mind and spoke, not loudly, but just enough for people outside the palace to hear.
"This is a serious matter."
He said: "Sun Wukong, this time you have to make a special trip to Lingshan to see how to handle this matter."
"The Heavenly Court has already done this for you. If something like this happens to the pilgrim, Lingshan should also know how to make a decision and let Lingshan handle it on its own."
title_en: Chapter 1513: Go find Buddhism. Lingshan is full of confusion. How could a Buddhist scripture seeker die? Chapter 1512: Sun Wukong’s fear. You are so powerful. Why did Tang Monk die?
